prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the hell's lantern. A great, slow, segmented worm-thing the size of a muffalo, with a long, low, heavy serpentine body made of many successive transverse segment rings, its back and flanks studded with large swollen pods that glow a sickly orange in the dusk of the root-maze. The hell's lantern crawls through the Miasma at barely a walking pace, grazing, paying no attention to anything around it. Its mandibles carry a venom that leaves anything bitten sick and weakened. Visible features it must show: a great slow segmented worm the size of a muffalo; swollen pods studding its back and sides, glowing sickly orange; venomous mandibles at the front. Every view shows the same worm: a long, low, thick-bodied worm about three times as long as it is wide, built of many rounded transverse rings of the same girth along the middle, with the same large orange pods in a row along the back at the same size and count. The side view shows the full length of the body in profile: a rounded head with mandibles at the front, then a long run of transverse segment rings crossing the body from back to belly, pods along the spine and upper flank, and a body that tapers to a blunt rounded tail end at the rear. The front view, eyes and mandibles toward the viewer, shows the head with its mandibles above a narrow rounded body, with the first segment rings and a few orange pods on the back, the body clearly narrower than the side view is long. The rear view, seen from behind, shows the same ring-segmented body from the tail end: a blunt rounded terminal segment, concentric transverse rings receding toward the head, narrower than the body is long, with the orange pods on top of the back, the head and mandibles hidden behind the body. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, clean dark outline, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background with the creature alone on it.

One consistent body across all views: the same bulk, the same width and the same antlers. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, clean dark outline, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour.
